catalogMeta.label: Say the Answer
catalogMeta.description: Name a displayed symbol or picture, or answer a spoken problem. Recall, not decoding. Show visual naming targets without speaking their names or printing answers.

fullData.title: Fun Word Riddles
fullData.description: Listen to each riddle and say the correct answer out loud.
fullData.gradeLevel: kindergarten students (ages 5-6) - Use clear language, relatable examples, foundational skills, and engaging visuals. Encourage exploration and basic problem-solving.

items.ask: I shine bright in the sky during the day and keep you warm. What am I?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.acceptRule: Saying a close synonym like sunshine or daylight counts as correct.
items.signatureError: Saying sky or hot is not the answer to this riddle.
items.correctionBody: The answer is sun because it shines in the sky and gives us warmth.

items.ask: I live in the water, I have fins, and I swim all day long. What am I?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.acceptRule: Saying fishes counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying water or boat is not the answer.
items.correctionBody: The answer is fish because they live in water and use fins to swim.

items.ask: I am a crunchy red or green fruit that grows on a tree and has a stem. What am I?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.acceptRule: Saying apples counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying tree or leaf is not the answer.
items.correctionBody: The answer is apple because it is a crunchy fruit that grows on trees.

items.ask: I have four legs, a furry tail, and I love to bark and play fetch. What am I?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.acceptRule: Saying puppy or hound counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying cat or tail is not the answer.
items.correctionBody: The answer is dog because they have four legs and bark.
